svg.title: Series of Five Paintings
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; not a facsimile. All five current museum color photographs inspected. Pairs shown in published photo order: red/yellow, red/blue, blue/green, black/white, yellow/blue. Museum explicitly says no prescribed order and prefers separated installation. This stacked comparison layout is not an actual installation or an overall physical width/height. Each part178×356cm; blue-green part uses observed teal-blue shade in the blue family. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green, yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.krollermuller.nl/en/what-s-on/exhibitions/birds-of-a-feather; record moma1973-pdf86-caption1; visual review 2026-10-28. Pure-vector study.
